summary.text: Mike Freiberg is a Democratic state representative from House District 43B, in office since 2023 and earlier from 2013 to 2023, who is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota Senate District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Freiberg lives in Golden Valley, Minnesota, and graduated from Breck School in 1995.
He earned a bachelor's degree in government and Russian from Georgetown University and a J.D. from William Mitchell College of Law in 2005.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an attorney, and says he served on the Golden Valley City Council.
Freiberg represented Minnesota House District 45B from 2013 to 2023 and has represented District 43B since January 3, 2023.
He is not seeking re-election to the House in 2026.
